pe_assessment: Frozen trailing27.96x/forward21.17x; forecast multiple looks more moderate, but cash reinvestment makes it insufficient alone. No exact normalised EPS inferred without tax treatment of legal/severance charges.

debt_analysis: Cash/securities$90.260bn versus long-term debt$83.664bn; noncurrent operating leases$26.229bn separately. Q2CFO31.862 less PP&E30.116 and finance-lease principal0.962=FCF0.784bn; H1FCF13.170bn versus18.883bn.
growth_outlook: Revenue+28%, impressions+14%, adprice+12%; monetisation grows. FY capex guidance$130-145bn and increased expense outlook require ad growth to sustain future owner cash.
key_risks: Q2 FCF0.784bn and H1FCF decline30.3% indicate material reinvestment pressure.
Margin remains lower even after illustrative charge addbacks; legal spending may recur and should not be assumed zero.
key_strengths: Strong monetisation and CFO growth demonstrate a profitable underlying ad franchise.
H1FCF remains positive and liquid assets exceed stated long-term debt, excluding leases.
summary: Meta retains strong ad growth but compressed cash conversion and operating margins. Neutral reflects these measured pressures; treating every legal charge as exceptional would overstate the recurring upside.
